environment.description: Spring Boot trading service deployed on EC2 in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing). Security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. ALB forwards WebSocket upgrade requests to target group on port 8080. No origin validation, no authentication token required on WebSocket handshake - userId is accepted from query parameter. Service is reachable from any internet client.
